evaluation_items = [item for item in dataset if item["split"] == "dev"]
print(f"전체 질문: {len(dataset)}개")
print(f"설정 선택용 dev 질문: {len(evaluation_items)}개")
manifest = json.loads((corpus / "manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
pages = []
for item in manifest:
    if item["tier"] == "scanned":
        continue
    reader = PdfReader(corpus / item["file"])
    for page_no, page in enumerate(reader.pages, start=1):
        text = page.extract_text() or ""
        if text.strip():
            pages.append({"doc_id": item["doc_id"], "page": page_no, "text": text})
print(f"검색 후보: {len(pages)}개 페이지")
def tokens(text):
    normalized = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text.lower())
    words = re.findall(r"[가-힣a-z0-9]+", normalized)
    compact = re.sub(r"[^가-힣a-z0-9]", "", normalized)
    return words + [compact[i:i+2] for i in range(max(0, len(compact)-1))]

def search(question, limit=50):
    query_counts = Counter(tokens(question))
    scored = []
    for page in pages:
        page_counts = Counter(tokens(page["text"]))
        overlap = sum(min(count, page_counts[token]) for token, count in query_counts.items())
        score = overlap / math.sqrt(max(1, sum(page_counts.values())))
        scored.append({"doc_id": page["doc_id"], "page": page["page"], "score": score})
    ranked_pages = sorted(scored, key=lambda row: (-row["score"], row["doc_id"], row["page"]))
    unique_docs, seen = [], set()
    for row in ranked_pages:
        if row["doc_id"] not in seen:
            unique_docs.append(row)
            seen.add(row["doc_id"])
    return unique_docs[:limit]

sample = search(dataset[0]["question"], 5)
print([(row["doc_id"], row["page"], round(row["score"], 3)) for row in sample])
required = {"qid", "tier", "question", "type", "gold_doc_ids", "answerable", "split"}
assert all(required == set(item) for item in dataset)
assert all("answer" not in item for item in dataset)
for item in dataset[:3]:
    print(item["qid"], item["tier"], item["split"], item["gold_doc_ids"], item["question"])
for size in (5, 15):
    subset = evaluation_items[:size]
    counts = Counter(doc_id for item in subset for doc_id in item["gold_doc_ids"])
    print(size, "문항:", dict(sorted(counts.items())))

import json, os
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from dotenv import find_dotenv, load_dotenv
from langchain_openai import OpenAIEmbeddings

# 현재 폴더부터 상위 폴더에서 .env를 찾고 키의 존재만 확인합니다.
env_file = find_dotenv(usecwd=True)
assert env_file, "프로젝트 루트에 .env를 준비하세요."
load_dotenv(env_file)
assert os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY"), "OPENAI_API_KEY를 확인하세요."
data_dir = Path("labs/part3/ch12-retrieval-tuning/data")
docs = json.loads((data_dir / "core-documents.json").read_text())
queries = json.loads((data_dir / "core-queries.json").read_text())
embedder = OpenAIEmbeddings(model="text-embedding-3-small", dimensions=256)
texts = [f"{doc['title']} {doc['text']}" for doc in docs]
doc_vectors = np.array(embedder.embed_documents(texts))
query_vectors = np.array([embedder.embed_query(q["question"]) for q in queries])
print("문서 벡터 모양:", doc_vectors.shape)
print("질문 벡터 모양:", query_vectors.shape)
print("첫 문서 벡터 L2 노름:", round(float(np.linalg.norm(doc_vectors[0])), 4))
def exact_rank(query_vector, metric="cosine", k=3):
    if metric == "cosine":
        scores = doc_vectors @ query_vector / (
            np.linalg.norm(doc_vectors, axis=1) * np.linalg.norm(query_vector)
        )
        order = np.argsort(-scores)[:k]
        return [(docs[i]["doc_id"], round(float(scores[i]), 4)) for i in order]
    distances = np.linalg.norm(doc_vectors - query_vector, axis=1)
    order = np.argsort(distances)[:k]
    return [(docs[i]["doc_id"], round(float(distances[i]), 4)) for i in order]

print("코사인 상위 3개:", exact_rank(query_vectors[0], "cosine"))
print("L2 상위 3개:", exact_rank(query_vectors[0], "l2"))
for metric in ["cosine", "l2"]:
    top_ids = [doc_id for doc_id, _ in exact_rank(query_vectors[1], metric)]
    print(metric, "순위:", top_ids, "정답 포함:", queries[1]["gold_doc_id"] in top_ids)
rows = []
for metric in ["cosine", "l2"]:
    for query, vector in zip(queries, query_vectors):
        ranked = [doc_id for doc_id, _ in exact_rank(vector, metric)]
        rows.append({"metric": metric, "qid": query["qid"], "ranked": ranked,
                     "hit": query["gold_doc_id"] in ranked})
for metric in ["cosine", "l2"]:
    selected = [row for row in rows if row["metric"] == metric]
    print(metric, "Recall@3:", sum(row["hit"] for row in selected), "/", len(selected))
runs = Path("labs/part3/ch12-retrieval-tuning/runs")
runs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
(runs / "core-01-exact.json").write_text(json.dumps(rows, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

data_dir = Path("labs/part3/ch12-retrieval-tuning/data")
docs = json.loads((data_dir / "core-documents.json").read_text())
queries = json.loads((data_dir / "core-queries.json").read_text())
embedder = OpenAIEmbeddings(model="text-embedding-3-small", dimensions=256)
import psycopg
from pgvector.psycopg import register_vector

dsn = "postgresql://student:local-practice-only@127.0.0.1:55432/rag_lab"
conn = psycopg.connect(dsn, autocommit=True)
register_vector(conn)
with conn.cursor() as cur:
    cur.execute("CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector")
    cur.execute("SELECT extversion FROM pg_extension WHERE extname='vector'")
    print("실제 pgvector 확장 버전:", cur.fetchone()[0])
vectors = embedder.embed_documents([f"{d['title']} {d['text']}" for d in docs])
with conn.cursor() as cur:
    cur.execute("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ch12_core_hnsw")
    cur.execute("CREATE TABLE ch12_core_hnsw (doc_id text PRIMARY KEY, category text, embedding vector(256))")
    cur.executemany("INSERT INTO ch12_core_hnsw VALUES (%s,%s,%s)",
                    [(d["doc_id"], d["category"], v) for d, v in zip(docs, vectors)])
    cur.execute("CREATE INDEX ch12_core_hnsw_idx ON ch12_core_hnsw USING hnsw (embedding vector_cosine_ops)")
print("저장한 문서:", len(vectors), "개")
qv = np.array(embedder.embed_query(queries[0]["question"]), dtype=np.float32)
def pg_rank(use_index, ef_search=40):
    with conn.transaction(), conn.cursor() as cur:
        cur.execute("SET LOCAL enable_seqscan = %s" % ("off" if use_index else "on"))
        cur.execute("SET LOCAL enable_indexscan = %s" % ("on" if use_index else "off"))
        cur.execute(f"SET LOCAL hnsw.ef_search = {int(ef_search)}")
        cur.execute("SELECT doc_id, round((embedding <=> %s)::numeric, 4) FROM ch12_core_hnsw ORDER BY embedding <=> %s LIMIT 3", (qv, qv))
        return cur.fetchall()

print("HNSW 검색:", pg_rank(True))

    print("ef_search=", ef, "순위:", [row[0] for row in result])

    for sql_type, dims in [("vector", 2001), ("halfvec", 2001)]:
        table = f"ch12_core_dim_{sql_type}"
        cur.execute(f"DROP TABLE IF EXISTS {table}")
        cur.execute(f"CREATE TABLE {table} (embedding {sql_type}({dims}))")
        try:
            cur.execute(f"CREATE INDEX ON {table} USING hnsw (embedding {sql_type}_cosine_ops)")
            outcome = "색인 생성 성공"
        except psycopg.Error as error:
            outcome = error.diag.message_primary
        checks.append({"type": sql_type, "dimensions": dims, "outcome": outcome})
        print(sql_type, dims, ":", outcome)
runs = Path("labs/part3/ch12-retrieval-tuning/runs"); runs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
(runs / "core-02-hnsw.json").write_text(json.dumps(checks, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

common = query + rng.normal(0, 0.01, size=(3000, 8))
rare = query + rng.normal(0, 0.18, size=(12, 8))
with conn.cursor() as cur:
    cur.execute("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ch12_core_filter")
    cur.execute("CREATE TABLE ch12_core_filter (id bigserial, category text, embedding vector(8))")
    rows = [("common", v) for v in common] + [("rare", v) for v in rare]
    cur.executemany("INSERT INTO ch12_core_filter(category, embedding) VALUES (%s,%s)", rows)
    cur.execute("CREATE INDEX ch12_core_filter_hnsw ON ch12_core_filter USING hnsw (embedding vector_cosine_ops)")
    cur.execute("ANALYZE ch12_core_filter")
print("common:", len(common), "rare:", len(rare))
def filtered(mode):
    with conn.transaction(), conn.cursor() as cur:
        cur.execute("SET LOCAL enable_seqscan=off")
        cur.execute("SET LOCAL hnsw.ef_search=5")
        assert mode in {"off", "strict_order"}
        cur.execute(f"SET LOCAL hnsw.iterative_scan={mode}")
        cur.execute("SELECT id, round((embedding <=> %s)::numeric,4) FROM ch12_core_filter WHERE category='rare' ORDER BY embedding <=> %s LIMIT 5", (query, query))
        return [(row_id, float(distance)) for row_id, distance in cur.fetchall()]
before = filtered("off")
print("Before 반환 개수:", len(before), "결과:", before)
after = filtered("strict_order")
print("After 반환 개수:", len(after), "결과:", after)
assert len(after) >= len(before)
result = {"ef_search": 5, "filter": "category=rare", "before_count": len(before),
          "after_count": len(after), "before": before, "after": after}
runs = Path("labs/part3/ch12-retrieval-tuning/runs"); runs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
(runs / "core-03-iterative-scan.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
conn.close()

embedder = OpenAIEmbeddings(model="text-embedding-3-small", dimensions=256)
from kiwipiepy import Kiwi
from rank_bm25 import BM25Okapi
texts = [f"{doc['title']} {doc['text']}" for doc in docs]

kiwi = Kiwi(); keep = ("N", "V", "VA", "MAG", "SN", "SL")

    scores = doc_vectors @ vector / (np.linalg.norm(doc_vectors, axis=1) * np.linalg.norm(vector))
    return [docs[i]["doc_id"] for i in np.argsort(-scores)[:k]]

    scores = bm25.get_scores(terms(question))
    order = sorted(range(len(docs)), key=lambda i: scores[i], reverse=True)[:k]
    return [docs[i]["doc_id"] for i in order]
def rrf(rankings, weights=None, rank_constant=60, k=3):
    weights = weights or [1.0] * len(rankings)
    scores = {}
    for ranking, weight in zip(rankings, weights):
        for rank, doc_id in enumerate(ranking, start=1):
            scores[doc_id] = scores.get(doc_id, 0.0) + weight / (rank_constant + rank)

from pathlib import Path
import json
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity

root = next(path for path in [Path.cwd(), *Path.cwd().parents] if (path / "labs/part3/ch12-retrieval-tuning").exists())
data = json.loads((root / "labs/part3/ch12-retrieval-tuning/data/advanced-documents.json").read_text())
queries = json.loads((root / "labs/part3/ch12-retrieval-tuning/data/advanced-queries.json").read_text())
chunks, parents = data["chunks"], {item["doc_id"]: item for item in data["parents"]}
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(analyzer="char_wb", ngram_range=(2, 4), min_df=1)
matrix = vectorizer.fit_transform([item["text"] for item in chunks])
print(f"부모 문서 {len(parents)}건 · 자식 청크 {len(chunks)}개 · 평가 질문 {len(queries)}개")
from sentence_transformers import CrossEncoder
from time import perf_counter

model_names = ["BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3", "Dongjin-kr/ko-reranker"]
models = {name: CrossEncoder(name, max_length=256, device="cpu") for name in model_names}
print("모델 준비:", list(models))
def eligible_items(subset):
    return [item for item in subset if item.get("answerable", True) and item["gold_doc_ids"]]

raw_dev_queries = [item for item in queries if item["split"] == "dev"]
dev_queries = eligible_items(raw_dev_queries)
excluded_query_count = len(raw_dev_queries) - len(dev_queries)
print("개발 문항:", len(dev_queries), "· 검색 평균 제외:", excluded_query_count)
candidate_sets = {}
for item in dev_queries:
    scores = cosine_similarity(vectorizer.transform([item["question"]]), matrix)[0]
    candidate_sets[item["qid"]] = np.argsort(-scores)[:20]
def score_fixed_candidates(model):
    started, scored = perf_counter(), {}
    for item in dev_queries:
        idxs = candidate_sets[item["qid"]]
        pairs = [(item["question"], chunks[i]["text"]) for i in idxs]
        scored[item["qid"]] = model.predict(pairs, show_progress_bar=False)
    return scored, perf_counter() - started
def evaluate(scored, candidate_k):
    if not dev_queries:
        raise ValueError("평가 가능한 개발 문항이 없습니다")
    recalls, ndcgs = [], []
    for item in dev_queries:
        idxs = candidate_sets[item["qid"]][:candidate_k]
        order = np.argsort(-scored[item["qid"]][:candidate_k])[:5]
        top_ids = list(dict.fromkeys(chunks[idxs[pos]]["parent_id"] for pos in order))
        gold = set(item["gold_doc_ids"])
        recalls.append(len(gold & {chunks[i]["parent_id"] for i in idxs}) / len(gold))
        rank = next((i for i, doc_id in enumerate(top_ids, 1) if doc_id in gold), None)
        ndcgs.append(0.0 if rank is None else 1 / np.log2(rank + 1))
    return float(np.mean(recalls)), float(np.mean(ndcgs))
rows = []
for name, model in models.items():
    scored, seconds = score_fixed_candidates(model)
    for candidate_k in (5, 10, 20):
        recall, ndcg = evaluate(scored, candidate_k)
        rows.append((name.split("/")[-1], candidate_k, recall, ndcg, seconds))
for row in rows:
    print(f"{row[0]:24s} k={row[1]:2d} recall={row[2]:.3f} nDCG={row[3]:.3f} time={row[4]:.2f}s")

import json
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity

from pathlib import Path
import json
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity

root = next(path for path in [Path.cwd(), *Path.cwd().parents] if (path / "labs/part3/ch12-retrieval-tuning").exists())
data_path = root / "labs/part3/ch12-retrieval-tuning/data/advanced-documents.json"
query_path = root / "labs/part3/ch11-evaluation/data/evaluation-queries.jsonl"
copy_path = root / "labs/part3/ch12-retrieval-tuning/data/advanced-queries.json"
data = json.loads(data_path.read_text())
queries = [json.loads(line) for line in query_path.read_text().splitlines() if line]
distributed_queries = json.loads(copy_path.read_text())
assert queries == distributed_queries, "Ch11 질문 원본과 Ch12 배포 복제본이 다릅니다."
chunks, parents = data["chunks"], {item["doc_id"]: item for item in data["parents"]}
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(analyzer="char_wb", ngram_range=(2, 4), min_df=1)
matrix = vectorizer.fit_transform([item["text"] for item in chunks])
print(f"부모 문서 {len(parents)}건 · 자식 청크 {len(chunks)}개 · 평가 질문 {len(queries)}개")
def eligible_items(subset):
    eligible = [item for item in subset if item.get("answerable", True) and item["gold_doc_ids"]]
    if not eligible:
        raise ValueError("평가 가능한 문항이 없습니다")
    return eligible

def metrics(candidate_ids, top_ids, gold_ids):
    gold = set(gold_ids)
    recall = len(gold & set(candidate_ids[:50])) / len(gold) if gold else 0.0
    recall_5 = len(gold & set(top_ids[:5])) / len(gold) if gold else 0.0
    precision = sum(doc_id in gold for doc_id in top_ids[:5]) / 5
    gains = [1.0 if doc_id in gold else 0.0 for doc_id in top_ids[:5]]
    dcg = sum(gain / np.log2(rank + 2) for rank, gain in enumerate(gains))
    ideal = sum(1 / np.log2(rank + 2) for rank in range(min(len(gold), 5)))
    return recall_5, recall, precision, dcg / ideal if ideal else 0.0
def mmr(query_vector, candidate_matrix, k=5, lambda_mult=0.5):
    relevance = cosine_similarity(query_vector, candidate_matrix)[0]
    selected, remaining = [], list(range(candidate_matrix.shape[0]))
    while remaining and len(selected) < k:
        if not selected:
            choice = max(remaining, key=lambda i: relevance[i])
        else:
            redundancy = cosine_similarity(candidate_matrix[remaining], candidate_matrix[selected]).max(axis=1)
            values = lambda_mult * relevance[remaining] - (1 - lambda_mult) * redundancy
            choice = remaining[int(np.argmax(values))]
        selected.append(choice)
        remaining.remove(choice)
    return selected
def evaluate_config(config, subset):
    eligible = eligible_items(subset)
    vec = TfidfVectorizer(analyzer=config["analyzer"], ngram_range=config["ngram"]).fit([c["text"] for c in chunks])
    docs, values, results = vec.transform([c["text"] for c in chunks]), [], []
    for item in eligible:
        qv = vec.transform([item["question"]])
        base = cosine_similarity(qv, docs)[0]
        candidates = np.argsort(-base)[:50]
        chosen = mmr(qv, docs[candidates], k=config["report_k"], lambda_mult=config["lambda"])
        candidate_ids = list(dict.fromkeys(chunks[idx]["parent_id"] for idx in candidates))
        top_results, seen = [], set()
        for pos in chosen:
            chunk = chunks[candidates[pos]]
            if chunk["parent_id"] not in seen:
                top_results.append({"doc_id": chunk["parent_id"], "page": chunk["page"], "chunk_id": chunk["chunk_id"], "rank": len(top_results) + 1})
                seen.add(chunk["parent_id"])
        top_ids = [row["doc_id"] for row in top_results]
        scores = metrics(candidate_ids, top_ids, item["gold_doc_ids"])
        values.append(scores)
        results.append({"qid": item["qid"], "tier": item["tier"], "split": item["split"], "gold_doc_ids": item["gold_doc_ids"], "returned_count": len(top_results), "candidate_doc_ids": candidate_ids, "top_results": top_results, "recall_at_5": scores[0], "recall_at_50": scores[1], "precision_at_5": scores[2], "ndcg_at_5": scores[3]})
    mean = np.mean(values, axis=0)
    metric_names = ("recall_at_5", "recall_at_50", "precision_at_5", "ndcg_at_5")
    summary = {name: float(mean[i]) for i, name in enumerate(metric_names)}
    slices = {tier: {name: float(np.mean([row[name] for row in results if row["tier"] == tier])) for name in metric_names} for tier in sorted({row["tier"] for row in results})}
    return summary, slices, results
from datetime import date, datetime
from itertools import product
from hashlib import sha256
from time import perf_counter

fingerprint = sha256(data_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
query_fingerprint = sha256(query_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
session_id = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")
rows = []
for analyzer, ngram, report_k, lam in product(("char", "char_wb"), ((2, 3), (2, 4), (3, 5)), (3, 5), (0.4, 0.8, 1.0)):
    settings = {"analyzer": analyzer, "ngram": ngram, "candidate_k": 50, "candidate_unit": "chunk", "report_k": report_k, "report_unit": "unique-parent-document", "lambda": lam}
    dev = [item for item in queries if item["split"] == "dev"]
    started = perf_counter()
    result, slices, details = evaluate_config(settings, dev)
    rows.append({"run_id": f"advanced-continuity-{session_id}-dev-{len(rows)+1:02d}", "run_date": str(date.today()), "source_chapter": "ch12", "query_source_chapter": "ch11", "query_source": str(query_path.relative_to(root)), "corpus_fingerprint": fingerprint, "query_fingerprint": query_fingerprint, "settings": settings, "evaluation_unit": "unique-parent-document", "metrics": result, "slices": slices, "results": details, "duration_ms": round((perf_counter() - started) * 1000, 2), "split": "dev", "query_count": len(dev), "excluded_query_count": len(dev) - len(details), "metrics_policy": "chunk-candidate-unique-parent-macro-v1", "comparison_policy": "compare-only-pairs-that-differ-by-one-setting"})
print("실험 로그 수:", len(rows))
print("첫 행 요약:", {key: rows[0][key] for key in ("run_id", "settings", "metrics", "query_count")})
run_dir = root / "labs/part3/ch12-retrieval-tuning/runs"
run_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
session_dir = run_dir / "continuity" / session_id
session_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
path = run_dir / "advanced-continuity-experiment-log.jsonl"
experiment_payload = "".join(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n" for row in rows)
path.write_text(experiment_payload)
(session_dir / path.name).write_text(experiment_payload)
best = max(rows, key=lambda row: row["metrics"]["ndcg_at_5"])
test = [item for item in queries if item["split"] == "test"]
test_started = perf_counter()
test_metrics, test_slices, test_results = evaluate_config(best["settings"], test)
test_path = run_dir / "advanced-continuity-test-result.json"
test_report = {"run_id": f"advanced-continuity-{session_id}-test-01", "run_date": str(date.today()), "selected_run_id": best["run_id"], "source_chapter": "ch12", "query_source_chapter": "ch11", "query_source": str(query_path.relative_to(root)), "settings": best["settings"], "evaluation_unit": "unique-parent-document", "metrics": test_metrics, "slices": test_slices, "results": test_results, "duration_ms": round((perf_counter() - test_started) * 1000, 2), "split": "test", "query_count": len(test), "excluded_query_count": len(test) - len(test_results), "corpus_fingerprint": fingerprint, "query_fingerprint": query_fingerprint, "metrics_policy": "chunk-candidate-unique-parent-macro-v1", "comparison_policy": "selected-on-dev-then-evaluate-test-once"}
test_payload = json.dumps(test_report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
test_path.write_text(test_payload)
(session_dir / test_path.name).write_text(test_payload)
print("저장:", path)
print("시험 결과 저장:", test_path)
print("개발 nDCG@5가 가장 높은 설정:", best["settings"])
print("개발 지표:", best["metrics"])
print("시험 지표:", test_metrics, "문항", len(test))
assert len(rows) >= 30 and len(dev) + len(test) == 30
from pypdf import PdfReader
from time import perf_counter

integration_started = perf_counter()
loaded_pages, integration_chunks = [], []
for parent in parents.values():
    pdf_path = root / "labs/data/rag-corpus" / parent["source"]
    pages = [page.extract_text() or "" for page in PdfReader(pdf_path).pages]
    for page_no, text in enumerate(pages, 1):
        loaded_pages.append(text)
        integration_chunks.append({"chunk_id": f"{parent['doc_id']}-P{page_no:02d}-C01", "parent_id": parent["doc_id"], "page": page_no, "text": text})
print("PDF 6건에서 읽은 페이지:", len(loaded_pages))
assert len(loaded_pages) >= 30 and all(page.strip() for page in loaded_pages)
print("통합 검색 입력 청크:", len(integration_chunks))
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from langchain_openai import OpenAIEmbeddings
from kiwipiepy import Kiwi
from rank_bm25 import BM25Okapi

load_dotenv(root / ".env")
target = next(item for item in queries if item["qid"] == "Q002")
assert target["split"] == "dev"
embedding = OpenAIEmbeddings(model="text-embedding-3-small")
dense_docs = np.array(embedding.embed_documents([item["text"] for item in integration_chunks]))
dense_query = np.array(embedding.embed_query(target["question"]))
dense_scores = cosine_similarity([dense_query], dense_docs)[0]
kiwi = Kiwi()
tokenized = [[token.form for token in kiwi.tokenize(item["text"])] for item in integration_chunks]
bm25 = BM25Okapi(tokenized)
sparse_scores = bm25.get_scores([token.form for token in kiwi.tokenize(target["question"])])
print("dense·sparse 점수:", len(dense_scores), len(sparse_scores))
def rrf_pair(first, second, rank_constant=60):
    scores = {}
    for ranking in (first, second):
        for rank, idx in enumerate(ranking, 1):
            scores[idx] = scores.get(idx, 0.0) + 1 / (rank_constant + rank)
    return sorted(scores, key=scores.get, reverse=True)

dense_rank = list(np.argsort(-dense_scores)[:50])
sparse_rank = list(np.argsort(-sparse_scores)[:50])
rrf_candidates = rrf_pair(dense_rank, sparse_rank)[:10]
from sentence_transformers import CrossEncoder
ce = CrossEncoder("BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3", max_length=256, device="cpu")
ce_scores = ce.predict([(target["question"], integration_chunks[i]["text"]) for i in rrf_candidates], show_progress_bar=False)
reranked = [rrf_candidates[pos] for pos in np.argsort(-ce_scores)]
print("RRF→CE 상위 청크:", [integration_chunks[i]["chunk_id"] for i in reranked[:5]])
retrieved, seen = [], set()
for idx in reranked:
    child = integration_chunks[idx]
    if child["parent_id"] in seen:
        continue
    retrieved.append({"doc_id": child["parent_id"], "page": child["page"], "chunk_id": child["chunk_id"], "text": child["text"]})
    seen.add(child["parent_id"])
    if len(retrieved) == 2:
        break
context = "\n\n".join(f"[{item['doc_id']} p.{item['page']} {item['chunk_id']}]\n{item['text']}" for item in retrieved)
print("부모 문서:", [(item["doc_id"], item["page"], item["chunk_id"]) for item in retrieved])
from langchain.chat_models import init_chat_model

chat = init_chat_model("openai:gpt-4.1-mini", temperature=0)
prompt = f"""아래 자료만 사용해 질문에 한국어로 답하세요.
답 끝에 [doc_id p.쪽] 형식으로 출처를 표시하세요.

질문: {target['question']}

자료:
{context}"""
answer = chat.invoke(prompt).text.strip()
print("답변:", answer)
integrated = {
    "run_id": f"advanced-continuity-{session_id}-integrated-01",
    "run_type": "generation_smoke_test",
    "qid": target["qid"], "split": target["split"], "question": target["question"], "gold_doc_ids": target["gold_doc_ids"],
    "retrieved": [{k: item[k] for k in ("doc_id", "page", "chunk_id")} for item in retrieved],
    "response": answer,
    "duration_ms": round((perf_counter() - integration_started) * 1000, 2),
    "retrieval_metrics": None,
    "generation_evaluation": {"status": "not_evaluated", "next_chapter": "Ch15"},
    "settings": {"input": "PDF page text", "dense": "text-embedding-3-small", "sparse": "Kiwi+BM25", "fusion": "RRF(k=60)", "reranker": "BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3", "context_selection": "matched-page-text", "chat": "gpt-4.1-mini"},
}
integrated_path = run_dir / "advanced-continuity-integrated-result.json"
integrated_payload = json.dumps(integrated, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
integrated_path.write_text(integrated_payload)
(session_dir / integrated_path.name).write_text(integrated_payload)
print("통합 결과:", integrated_path)
print("전체 시간:", integrated["duration_ms"], "ms")
